title: build(archive): stabilize release archive metadata
body:
## Summary

Sort the entries and normalize mtime and numeric owner/group in `scripts/archive.sh`; use `gzip -n`. Expand `docs/releasing.md` with the epoch default, GNU tar prerequisite, and the unnormalized content and permission bits.

## Rationale

The reason is to sort entries, normalize the tar metadata, suppress the gzip header metadata, and describe the settings in the release guide.

## Checks proposed

Build two archives from files with identical contents and modes but different mtimes and creation order, then compare hashes and extracted bytes. Check the unset epoch and a supplied epoch separately.

## Limits

GNU tar is required. Content and permission-bit differences remain visible in the archive.

files.patch:
diff --git a/scripts/archive.sh b/scripts/archive.sh
--- a/scripts/archive.sh
+++ b/scripts/archive.sh
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 set -euo pipefail
-tar -czf "$1" dist
+tar --sort=name --mtime="@${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH:-0}" --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner -cf - dist | gzip -n > "$1"

diff --git a/docs/releasing.md b/docs/releasing.md
--- a/docs/releasing.md
+++ b/docs/releasing.md
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 # Release archive
 
 Run `scripts/archive.sh package.tar.gz` from the repository root after building dist/.
-The packaging host must provide tar and gzip.
+The packaging host must provide GNU tar and gzip.
+Archive entries are sorted by name, owned by numeric user/group 0, and timestamped from SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (default 0).
+Gzip headers omit the source name and timestamp. File contents and permission bits are not normalized.
